title: Cosmic Spellforge Ritual
description: Three glowing humanoid figures in green, blue, and red stand back-to-back inside a swirling cauldron, their arms raised high to hold a green glowing chain descending from above. The dark starry sky is filled with floating papers, mathematical symbols, colorful light streaks, and handprints circling in a vortex around the central figures.
prompt: Surreal cosmic ritual scene featuring three translucent glowing humanoid figures colored green, blue, and red standing back-to-back inside a large metal cauldron. Their arms are raised together holding a glowing green chain from above. Dark starry night sky filled with floating papers containing mathematical equations, colorful light streaks and energy trails swirling in a vortex, scattered handprints in the swirling patterns, dramatic fantasy atmosphere with vibrant luminous colors.
